newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends down vs dollar at 1,060.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends down vs dollar at 1,060.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.1 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,060 but well off its intraday low, interbank dealers said.

They said dollar-buying by banks put downward pressure on the peso throughout the trading session and drove it to a low of 1,063 shortly before the close. But the local currency pared its losses in the final moments of trading and ended three pesos higher.
Dealers reported $163 million in traders and said the peso's high for the day was 1,056.15.
